content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 21-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) under the Industrial Research & Development (IRD) unit.

faq.question: Q2. What positions are available in IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions are Project Scientist and Jr. Project Assistant (Tech.) for research-based projects at IIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are announced in this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies have been announced, which includes 1 post for Project Scientist and 2 posts for Jr. Project Assistant (Tech.).

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Project Scientist?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a B.Tech or B.E degree in CSE, Electronics, or Mechanical with a minor in Data Science, securing 1st class or equivalent along with 2 years of relevant work experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for Jr. Project Assistant (Tech.)?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.Tech, B.Sc, or B.E degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or Mechanical Engineering with 1st class or equivalent.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 29,290 to 62,350 per month plus 30% HRA, depending upon the specific post and qualifications.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply for IIT Delhi Jobs 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 21 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply via email by sending their filled Form No. IRD/REC-4 and supporting documents to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for IIT Delhi project appointments?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates based on their qualifications followed by an online interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification link?
faq.answer: You can check the official website at http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec and find direct notification links in the important links section of this article.
